quests.passage: Maria felt happy all through dinner because her brother was finally coming home for the weekend.
quests.question: feeling pleased or glad
quests.hint: Look at how Maria is feeling about her brother's visit.
quests.explanation: 'Happy' describes a good feeling you get when something pleasant happens. Maria feels happy because her brother is visiting.
quests.wordInContext: Grandma looked happy the moment she opened the door and saw her grandchildren.

quests.passage: The last question on the test was so difficult that half the class left it blank.
quests.question: hard to do or understand
quests.hint: Notice what the students did — they couldn't finish this part.
quests.explanation: 'Difficult' describes a task that takes a lot of effort or skill to complete. Something difficult is not easy to do.
quests.wordInContext: Learning to ride a bike felt difficult at first, but it got easier with practice.

quests.passage: Dad couldn't talk on the phone because the kitchen was busy, with three pots boiling and the oven timer beeping.
quests.question: having a lot to do at one time
quests.hint: Think about what's happening in the kitchen right now.
quests.explanation: 'Busy' means having many things to do, so there is little free time. A busy kitchen is full of activity.
quests.wordInContext: The restaurant gets busy around seven o'clock, when most people come in for dinner.

quests.passage: The hotel room was tiny, with just enough space for a bed, so our bags had to stay in the hallway.
quests.question: very small in size
quests.hint: How much room does the description suggest this place has?
quests.explanation: 'Tiny' means extremely small. The passage shows this through the lack of space for anything else.
quests.wordInContext: A tiny kitten was hiding behind the sofa, too small to be seen at first.

quests.passage: Dad gave everyone a quick hug and grabbed his keys, already halfway out the door before we could say goodbye.
quests.question: done or happening in a short amount of time
quests.hint: Watch how much time Dad actually spends with the family here.
quests.explanation: 'Quick' describes something that happens fast, often over in a short time. Dad's goodbye barely lasts a moment.
quests.wordInContext: We only had time for a quick lunch before the train left the station.

quests.passage: The vegetables at the corner stall were so cheap that Grandpa always shopped there instead of the big supermarket.
quests.question: costing very little money
quests.hint: Think about why Grandpa chooses this stall over the supermarket.
quests.explanation: 'Cheap' means low in price. Grandpa prefers the stall because its prices are much lower than the supermarket's.
quests.wordInContext: These sandals were so cheap that she bought two pairs without thinking twice.

quests.passage: One bite of the delicious soup and Tom asked his mother for the recipe, saying he had never tasted anything like it.
quests.question: having a wonderful taste
quests.hint: Think about Tom's reaction after only one bite.
quests.explanation: 'Delicious' describes food or drink with a very pleasant taste. Tom's excitement over the soup shows how good it is.
quests.wordInContext: The bakery's cinnamon rolls smelled delicious the moment they came out of the oven.

quests.passage: After the children fell asleep, the house grew quiet, and Anna could hear the clock ticking in the hallway.
quests.question: making very little or no noise
quests.hint: Notice what Anna can suddenly hear now that everyone is asleep.
quests.explanation: 'Quiet' means having little or no sound. Anna can hear the clock because nothing else is making noise.
quests.wordInContext: The library stayed quiet all afternoon, except for the soft sound of turning pages.

quests.passage: Since Omar started jogging every morning and eating more vegetables, his doctor says his heart is healthy and strong now, much better than it was last year.
quests.question: in good physical condition, not sick
quests.hint: Think about what Omar changed and what his doctor noticed as a result.
quests.explanation: 'Healthy' describes being physically well and free from illness. Omar's new habits have improved his physical condition.
quests.wordInContext: Fresh fruit and regular sleep are two simple ways to stay healthy.

quests.passage: The final goal was so exciting that the whole stadium jumped to their feet in the last ten seconds of the match.
quests.question: causing strong feelings of interest or energy
quests.hint: Think about how the crowd reacted to that last-second goal.
quests.explanation: 'Exciting' describes something that makes people feel eager or thrilled. The crowd's reaction shows the moment was thrilling to watch.
quests.wordInContext: The last chapter of the book was so exciting that she stayed up reading until midnight.

quests.passage: The dorm room was messy, with clothes on the floor, dishes in the sink, and papers scattered across every surface.
quests.question: untidy or disorganized
quests.hint: Picture the room based on where the clothes, dishes, and papers ended up.
quests.explanation: 'Messy' describes a place or thing that is not neat or organized. The scattered items across the room paint that picture.
quests.wordInContext: His desk gets messy by Friday, with pens and notes piled everywhere.

quests.passage: Instead of following the long recipe with ten steps, she used a simple method: just mix three ingredients and bake for twenty minutes.
quests.question: not complicated; easy to do or understand
quests.hint: Compare what she chose to do with the longer recipe mentioned first.
quests.explanation: 'Simple' means not complicated or hard to follow. Her three-step method is much easier than the original recipe.
quests.wordInContext: The instructions for setting up the lamp were simple enough for a child to follow.

quests.passage: The nurse was careful with the baby's medicine, checking the label twice to make sure the amount was exactly right.
quests.question: acting with close attention to avoid mistakes
quests.hint: Notice why the nurse checks the label more than once.
quests.explanation: 'Careful' means paying close attention so nothing goes wrong. Checking twice shows the nurse is being cautious with the baby's medicine.
quests.wordInContext: Drivers should be extra careful on icy roads, since a small mistake can cause an accident.

quests.passage: By eight in the morning, the train platform was crowded, with commuters standing shoulder to shoulder waiting for the doors to open.
quests.question: full of people, with little space
quests.hint: Picture how much room passengers have while waiting on this platform.
quests.explanation: 'Crowded' describes a place filled with many people, often leaving little room to move. The packed platform is a clear example.
quests.wordInContext: The beach gets crowded every weekend once the weather turns warm.

quests.passage: The vet lifted the injured bird with a gentle touch, speaking in a low voice so it wouldn't be frightened.
quests.question: kind and soft in manner, not rough
quests.hint: Think about how the vet is handling something fragile.
quests.explanation: 'Gentle' describes a soft, careful way of acting, especially toward something delicate. The vet's light touch and calm voice show this.
quests.wordInContext: She gave the puppy a gentle pat, careful not to startle it.

quests.passage: The jacket in the window was so expensive that it cost more than her monthly rent, so she just admired it through the glass.
quests.question: costing a lot of money
quests.hint: Compare the jacket's price to something else in the passage.
quests.explanation: 'Expensive' means costing a large amount of money. Comparing the price to her rent shows just how costly the jacket is.
quests.wordInContext: Flights get expensive during the holidays, so they booked their tickets months early.

quests.passage: The bread at the market was still fresh and warm, baked only an hour earlier that same morning.
quests.question: recently made and not yet old or stale
quests.hint: Think about when the bread was actually made.
quests.explanation: 'Fresh' describes something recently made or picked, not old or stale. The bread's warmth shows it was just baked.
quests.wordInContext: They picked fresh strawberries from the garden and ate them right away.

quests.passage: The small flashlight in his backpack turned out to be more useful than anything else he packed for the camping trip.
quests.question: helping to do or get something you want; practical
quests.hint: Notice what the flashlight actually did for him on the trip.
quests.explanation: 'Useful' describes something that helps in a practical way. The flashlight proved its worth by being more helpful than other items.
quests.wordInContext: A good pair of walking shoes is useful for exploring a new city.

quests.passage: After working a double shift at the hospital, Priya felt so tired that she could barely keep her eyes open on the drive home.
quests.question: needing rest because of a lack of energy
quests.hint: Think about how a long, double shift would leave Priya feeling.
quests.explanation: 'Tired' describes feeling low on energy and needing rest. Priya struggling to stay awake shows she is exhausted from work.
quests.wordInContext: The kids were too tired to finish the movie and fell asleep on the couch.

quests.passage: The teacher's story about his cat was so funny that the whole class ended up laughing until their sides hurt.
quests.question: causing amusement or laughter
quests.hint: Look at how the class reacts to this story.
quests.explanation: 'Funny' describes something that makes people laugh or smile. The class laughing hard shows the story is amusing.
quests.wordInContext: The comedian's jokes about airport travel were so funny that the whole audience was in tears.

quests.passage: It was a brave thing to do: without waiting for the firefighters, the young man ran back into the smoke to carry his neighbor's dog to safety.
quests.question: willing to face danger without giving in to fear
quests.hint: Think about the risk this young man was willing to take for someone else.
quests.explanation: 'Brave' describes facing danger or fear with courage. Running into smoke to save a dog shows real bravery.
quests.wordInContext: It took a brave decision for her to speak up against her boss during the meeting.

quests.passage: He was so clumsy on his way to the front of the classroom that he knocked over two chairs and tripped over his own shoelaces.
quests.question: awkward in movement and likely to drop or bump things
quests.hint: Notice how many small accidents happen on the way to the front.
quests.explanation: 'Clumsy' describes moving in an awkward way that often causes small accidents. Knocking over chairs and tripping shows this.
quests.wordInContext: The new waiter was a bit clumsy on his first night and dropped two plates.

quests.passage: Even though it was her first time presenting to the whole company, Lena seemed confident, walking to the front with her head held high and speaking without checking her notes once.
quests.question: sure of your own abilities, without fear or doubt
quests.hint: Look at how Lena carries herself despite this being her first big presentation.
quests.explanation: 'Confident' means feeling sure of yourself and your abilities. Lena's calm posture and steady speaking show she isn't doubting herself.
quests.wordInContext: After months of practice, he felt confident enough to sing the solo without notes.

quests.passage: The menu looked completely foreign to them, printed in a language they didn't recognize with dish names from a country they had never visited.
quests.question: coming from or belonging to a country that is not your own
quests.hint: Think about why the language and dish names feel unfamiliar to them.
quests.explanation: 'Foreign' describes something from another country, not your own. The unfamiliar language and dish names point to this.
quests.wordInContext: Working in a foreign country taught her to communicate even when she didn't know the local language well.

quests.passage: The mechanic stayed patient, explaining the same problem three different ways without once raising his voice, until the customer finally understood.
quests.question: able to wait or deal with problems calmly, without getting annoyed
quests.hint: Consider how the mechanic reacts to explaining something more than once.
quests.explanation: 'Patient' describes staying calm while waiting or dealing with something difficult, without becoming frustrated. The mechanic's calm repetition shows this quality.
quests.wordInContext: Good teachers stay patient with students who need extra time to understand a topic.

quests.passage: The singer has become so popular that tickets for her concert sold out in under ten minutes, with fans already asking about a second show.
quests.question: liked or enjoyed by many people
quests.hint: Think about how quickly and strongly people responded to this concert.
quests.explanation: 'Popular' means liked or supported by a large number of people. Selling out in minutes shows the singer has many fans.
quests.wordInContext: That noodle shop has become so popular that people line up outside before it even opens.

quests.passage: The curry was so spicy that one spoonful made his eyes water, and he had to drink two glasses of milk to cool his tongue.
quests.question: having a strong, hot taste, often from chili or pepper
quests.hint: Notice his physical reaction after just one spoonful.
quests.explanation: 'Spicy' describes food with a strong, burning taste, often from chili. His watering eyes and need for milk show the curry's heat.
quests.wordInContext: She always asks the waiter to make her curry less spicy than usual.

quests.passage: The old farmhouse had been replaced with a modern glass building full of touch screens, sensors, and solar panels on every roof.
quests.question: using the newest ideas, methods, or technology
quests.hint: Compare what used to stand there with what replaced it.
quests.explanation: 'Modern' describes something new, using current ideas or technology, as opposed to old or traditional. The glass building with sensors and solar panels contrasts with the old farmhouse.
quests.wordInContext: Their office moved into a modern building with automatic lights and charging stations at every desk.

quests.passage: Noor felt sick and stayed home from school with a fever and a sore throat, sipping tea while wrapped in a blanket on the sofa.
quests.question: not feeling well; suffering from an illness
quests.hint: Look at Noor's symptoms and what she is doing because of them.
quests.explanation: 'Sick' means unwell or suffering from illness. Noor's fever, sore throat, and staying home show she isn't feeling well.
quests.wordInContext: Half the office called in sick after the same stomach bug went around last week.

quests.passage: The roller coaster ride was so thrilling that the moment it ended, half the riders ran straight back to the line to go again.
quests.question: extremely exciting, causing a rush of strong feeling
quests.hint: Notice what the riders do the instant the ride is over.
quests.explanation: 'Thrilling' describes an intense, exciting feeling, often from danger or a fast experience. Riders rushing back for more shows how exciting the ride was.
quests.wordInContext: Skydiving for the first time was the most thrilling experience of his life.
